# Files Customization

This is an unofficial fork of [Files 4.3](https://github.com/files-community/Files) that adds a few more ways to customize the app.


## Features

**Sidebar** — Arrange items in the order you prefer, put them into custom groups, and add separators or extra space. You can change labels, text and icon sizes, visibility, expansion behavior, duplicate an item, and adjust spacing. Choose between the default layout and a Legacy style inspired by the classic Files sidebar.

**Column details** — Choose your default columns, drag them into order, and decide how they should fit: to their contents, or to the window width.

**Shortcut badges** — Hide the small arrow on shortcut icons for Desktop items or throughout Files. 


## Get started

Open **Settings**, choose **Customization** at the bottom of the Settings sidebar, and turn on the features you want to use. Disabling any feature will use the original app code and will restore default behavior.

For packaged builds and installation instructions, check [Releases](https://github.com/ymbasss/Files-Customization/releases).

To build the app from the source, follow the Files team's [building from source guide](https://files.community/docs/contributing/building-from-source).
